verdict.rationale: The README documents what the skill does: it turns the agent into an identity designer working from brief to SVG files and guidelines, with a staged workflow. It also explains predictable checkpoints ('Nothing else is produced until you choose a direction'). On activation, it says you start a session, ask for a logo, and the agent picks the skill up from its SKILL.md description. Missing for 10: the actual SKILL.md description/trigger text is not shown, there is no explicit list of activation conditions or exclusions, and there is no independent corroboration of how activation behaves.

support.subject: As a developer, every skill documents what it does and when it activates, so I can predict my agent's new behavior before it surprises me
